notes: Recorded 2026-11-11 on blade18 (Mopic display, game UI 16:10 with pillar bars) with UEVR c1ecaa87 (PR #28, the Slate.DrawToVRRenderTarget latch). NEEDS a UEVR with PR #28: the release v1.0.5.5 (86a80185) draws none of the game's UI on the Mopic display, so the title never matches here (run with -Dll runs\dlls\uevr-c1ecaa87\UEVRBackend.dll, or a build of mopic/joeyhodge-base from c1ecaa87 on, until a release has it). Route: the PlayStation PC SDK Runtime error box (about 30 s after the window, when the runtime is not installed: dismiss_dialog presses its OK, control id 2) > the title menu about 50 s later (이어서 하기 / 새로운 게임 / 불러오기 / 설정 / 게임 종료; no press-any-key screen, the cursor starts on 이어서 하기) > 2 x down to 불러오기 > Space > the 불러오기 list (one card per save file; the cursor is on the first) > Space loads it at once (no confirmation; the prologue beach took under 4 s) > play (W/A/S/D, mouse camera, left click = quick attack; never 새로운 게임) > Esc opens the pause menu on its 장비 tab > E to the last tab 설정 > 11 x down to 나가기 (the list does not wrap) > Space > the right panel with 메인 메뉴로 나가기 / 게임을 종료하고 나가기 > down > Space > 게임 종료 dialog (SPACE 예 / ESC 아니요) > Space. Keys: Space confirm, Esc back, Q/E switch the pause menu's tabs. The UEVR menu opens at every start in this profile (FrameworkConfig_RememberMenuState=false, MenuOpen=true): the recipe's config keeps it closed. The prologue beach save starts in the combat tutorial (an enemy and a quick-attack prompt): random keys may lose the fight; a death screen ends the run in MENU_FAIL at pause_menu (no harm).

steps.note: without the PlayStation PC SDK Runtime: its error box (about 30 s after the window; not at every start) stops the game's main thread until OK
Space loads the first card (the newest save) right away

steps.keys: w a s d w w
w w a w d s w lmb lmb

steps.note: the settings list does not wrap: 11 presses always end on 나가기 (the 11th item)
